title: Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,183.08 up 154.79 points
text:
Shutterstock photo Wednesday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,183.08. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.49 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 2.29 to 1 ratio. There were 2180 advancers and 950 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 17 stocks reached a 52 week high and 9 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up 2.64% for the day; a total of 175.12 points. The current value is 6,807.91. Illumina, Inc. ( ILMN ) had the largest percent change down (-4.45%) while Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. ( AMD ) had the largest percent change gain rising 19.95%.
The Dow Jones index closed up 1.77% for the day; a total of 434.9 points. The current value is 25,014.86. Walmart Inc. ( WMT ) had the largest percent change down (-1.97%) while Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change gain rising 6.83%.
